name: template-library-shareable
body: Forward compatibility with git-based sharing (future, out of scope now): the `templates/` directory must be a self-contained, relocatable unit — it must not reference files outside itself (no absolute paths, no `..` escapes, no references into `slides/` or the project `assets/`), must carry its identity and format version in `templates/library.yaml`, and must hold no machine- or project-specific state — so that it can later be the root of (or be pulled from) its own git repository without layout changes.
